title: California: look up a saved five-tier report
question: What tier does an exact school code receive in the selected saved indicator report?
scope: Dated 2026 Dashboard /2025–26 school-year analysis. The two saved reports use withholding price .20 and at most five tiers. Only school code, indicator and grade are staged from the unit file. No model is fitted or report optimized.
unitHighlightScope: Exact14-digit school-code lookup in the complete indicator-specific stored frame. Unknown or absent codes produce no grade; only one selected row is rendered.

scenarios.label: Chronic absence: five tiers
notes: Tier 1 corresponds to lower event propensity, which is more favorable; the common higher-priority target coordinate is negative propensity. These tiers are not official Status-and-Change colors.

This is a separate single-indicator report, conditional on the fitted empirical Bayes mixing distribution and the declared posterior-mean order. Fixed-order optimality is not unrestricted ordered-partition optimality.
The mean error does not bound every comparison. The withholding price .20 is a loss weight, not an individual error cap.
A school code is looked up only within the selected stored frame. The two indicators use different student populations and must not be combined into a joint report.
scenarios.rowCaption: Selected school code and its saved tier; no names or new grades inferred
